# Is a cost segregation study worth the fee?

> Free cost segregation study calculator for rental and commercial property owners. Estimates first-year extra depreciation, tax saved at your bracket, fee payback, the recapture bill on sale and a present-value net. Illustrative; an engineer and your CPA decide. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
